issue.title: agents_retry_e2e PNG goldens embed unseeded random hex agent-delta artifact IDs and drift between runs
issue.description: Proposed by sase-16n.11.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2). Details are in the flake report below.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase bead sase-16n.11.4 (epic sase-16n.11, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2) while capturing the project-tag PNG goldens:

The agents_retry_e2e PNG goldens (countdown / running_fallback / completed_chain:
`test_real_fakey_retry_countdown_png_snapshot`, `test_real_fakey_running_fallback_png_snapshot`, and `test_real_fakey_completed_retry_chain_png_snapshot` in tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py) render agent-delta artifact IDs that contain unseeded random hex. The captured frames therefore change from run to run on an unchanged tree. This is unrelated to project tags, and the phase left these goldens untouched.

Reported signature: the drift reproduces between two consecutive fix-tui-screenshots runs on the same tree, with only the hex IDs changing. The fail rate was not measured. The remedy is to seed or pin the ID source in the visual harness (or the fixture), not to regenerate the goldens.

Related history: closed sase-13v and sase-dc covered other failure signatures of the same retry-e2e tests (DONE-sentinel timeouts, a 491-pixel drift, and contention). This report has a different root cause: unseeded IDs.
